title: CapabilityDescriptor
description: What an adapter (model provider, data source, vector index) supports. A caller checks it before use; an operation not listed fails with `unsupported_operation`, never a silent fallback.

limits.description: Hard upper bounds the adapter enforces, e.g. `maxRows`, `maxInputTokens`, `maxBytes`.

attributes.description: Kind-specific flags, e.g. modalities for a model.
